correctness.rationale: Explicit gauge transformations for both source ODEs preserve the complete state derivatives identically under changes of the constant interaction parameters. A one-parameter c-to-delta transformation proves nonidentifiability even without the x^4 != 1 regularity condition. Smoothness and strict positivity constraints persist locally under small parameter changes, and symbolic substitution verifies all residual identities exactly.

originality.rationale: General identifiability theory for unknown time-varying inputs is prior art and is excluded from the novelty claim. Searches found no SCOPE overlap or public source-specific correction of arXiv:2609.20793 deriving this explicit gauge family, its positivity persistence, or the partial identifiability restoration obtained when one time-varying rate is independently known.

value.rationale: The source presents structural identifiability as justification for simultaneous estimation of time-dependent rates and constant interaction parameters. The gauge shows that the intended non-autonomous ODE is structurally nonidentifiable even with perfect continuous observation of both species, and identifies what additional information is needed to break the ambiguity.
